title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96 > adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac
source: source: aud cassette master taped by Doug Lamarre  sennheiser 441's > sony d5, maxell xl-II90's

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience field recording captures the Coliseum’s massive sing‑along but sacrifices instrument clarity.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the overwhelming crowd sound and the feeling of being inside the arena, calling it a fantastic document of the band–audience synergy. However they note that the band's own playing is less clearly captured than in other sources, making the recording more about ambience than musical detail.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review with mixed comments; positive about atmosphere but negative about band clarity, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Excellent crowd ambience and arena feel; instrument and vocal detail are muffled compared to typical soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or song performance.
